info.brief: Functions to use the Xsolla Shop Builder API.
info.description: Functions to use the Xsolla Shop Builder API.

elements.name: shop.set_username_password
elements.description: Set a username and password for basic authentication

elements.name: shop.set_merchant_auth
elements.description: Set merchant id and api key for use with 'basicMerchantAuth' authentication

parameters.name: project_id (REQUIRED)
parameters.doc: Project ID. You can find this parameter in your [Publisher Account](https://publisher.xsolla.com/) next to the name of the project.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.doc: Limit for the number of elements on the page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.doc: Number of the element from which the list is generated (the count starts from 0).

parameters.name: locale
parameters.doc: Response language. Two-letter lowercase language code per ISO 639-1.

parameters.name: additional_fields
parameters.doc: The list of additional fields. These fields will be in the response if you send them in your request.

parameters.name: country
parameters.doc: Two-letter uppercase country code per [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2). Check the documentation for detailed information about [countries supported by Xsolla](https://developers.xsolla.com/doc/shop-builder/references/supported-countries/) and [the process of determining the country](https://developers.xsolla.com/doc/shop-builder/features/pricing-policy/#pricing_policy_country_determination).

parameters.name: promo_code
parameters.doc: Unique case sensitive code. Contains letters and numbers.

parameters.name: show_inactive_time_limited_items
parameters.doc: Shows time-limited items that are not available to the user. The validity period of such items has not started or has already expired.

          enable = true,

        info =

      is_payment_methods_list_mode = true,
